label: bright palette
description: Overall lightness and brightness of the image.

label: saturated color
description: Vivid, intense color rather than muted or neutral color.

label: warm color temperature
description: Warm reds, oranges, yellows, golds, creams, or sunlit warmth.

label: high contrast
description: Strong tonal or color contrast with crisp separation.

label: blue-dominant palette
description: Blue or cool cyan is a dominant color family.

label: minimal composition
description: Spacious, restrained composition with few competing elements.

label: editorial composition
description: Magazine-like art direction, refined hierarchy, campaign styling.

label: dynamic composition
description: Motion, diagonals, asymmetry, or kinetic visual energy.

label: cluttered layout
description: Busy layout with many competing objects, labels, or badges.

label: spatial depth
description: Layered foreground/background space rather than flat poster layout.

label: human presence
description: People, faces, hands, models, or human lifestyle cues are visible.

label: product prominence
description: The product or offer object is clear and central.

label: lifestyle context
description: Product appears in lived context, scene, activity, or aspiration.

label: product-only staging
description: Product is staged alone without lifestyle scene or people.

label: coastal or beach setting
description: Beach, water, sand, summer, resort, or coastal outdoor cues.

label: urban setting
description: Street, city, architecture, nightlife, or metropolitan context.

label: studio product setting
description: Controlled studio, seamless background, or deliberate set styling.

label: home interior setting
description: Home, room, sofa, tabletop, domestic, or interior lifestyle cues.

label: sunny lighting
description: Bright natural daylight or sunlit atmosphere.

label: moody lighting
description: Low-key, shadowy, dramatic, dim, or atmospheric lighting.

label: synthetic lighting
description: Neon, hard artificial light, glossy AI glow, or unrealistic lighting.

label: soft natural lighting
description: Soft believable natural light without harsh artificial effects.

label: clean typography
description: Simple refined type, good spacing, clear hierarchy.

label: playful typography
description: Decorative, expressive, sticker-like, or playful letterforms.

label: high text density
description: Lots of text, dense copy, or many written claims in the image.

label: strong sale emphasis
description: Prominent sale, discount, urgency, percent-off, or promo language.

label: subtle offer treatment
description: Offer is understated, quiet, member-like, or secondary to image mood.

label: CTA prominence
description: Call-to-action or shopping instruction is visually prominent.

label: brand presence
description: Logo, brand name, brand marks, or owned design language are visible.

label: platform-native feel
description: Feels native to social feed rather than like a generic ad template.

label: scroll-stopping intensity
description: Strong immediate attention-grabbing visual intensity.

label: template-like feel
description: Looks like a generic stock template or reusable promo graphic.

label: UGC/native creator feel
description: Feels like user-generated or creator-native content rather than polished brand advertising.

label: premium mood
description: High-end, expensive, elevated, luxury, or refined feeling.

label: credible tone
description: Trustworthy, professional, realistic, and believable for the brand.

label: playful mood
description: Fun, light, quirky, casual, or playful tone.

label: energetic mood
description: Exciting, kinetic, bold, urgent, or active mood.

label: calm mood
description: Quiet, restful, restrained, serene, or calm mood.

label: cheap-looking cues
description: Low-quality, bargain-bin, generic, unrefined, or off-brand cheapness.

label: audience fit
description: Feels appropriate for the target customer's taste and expectations.

label: category convention fit
description: Fits or intentionally breaks conventions of the business category.

label: product clarity
description: The product, service, or offer is easy to understand quickly.
